title: Mossvale SMP Server Pack
description: The official curated server pack for the Mossvale SMP. Built for longterm worlds, stability, and smooth Fabric performance, this pack enhances vanilla Minecraft without overwhelming it.
body:
Mossvale is a lightweight Fabric multiplayer modpack designed for long-term survival, community building, exploration, and relaxed progression while keeping the core Minecraft experience intact.  

Included Mods:  

AllTheHeads  
Camerapture  
Cardinal Components API  
Copper Rails  
Fabric API  
Forge Config API Port  
Puzzles Lib  
Traveler’s Backpack  

This pack is designed for multiplayer use and is compatible with the official Mossvale server configuration.
